name: Riley Mills
source:
Riley is a senior year high school student. She loves her family and friends a lot, also playing games. Her dad is on a long business trip so she's staying with her mom at home.
She doesn't like going to school. She's only there for the school's computer club that she leads. She has a big passion for computer stuff. She is currently practicing programming and graphic design to work on Candice's website.
She seems to be really fond of romantic things like otome games, shoujo manga, etc... but she doesn't like to admit it.
